question.prompt: Roll a standard die and consider the following 4 events: ① the number rolled is greater than 6; ② the number rolled is less than 7; ③ the number rolled is 3; ④ the number rolled is even. How many of these are random events?

solutions.explanation: ① Rolling a number greater than 6 is impossible; ② rolling a number less than 7 is certain; ③ rolling a 3 and ④ rolling an even number may or may not occur, so they are random events. There are 2 in total.
solutions.title: Classifying all four events
